title: File-change attribution scans every eligible session for high-churn TermAl test-state SQLite WAL files under worktree .tmp, and reports them as unresolved changes
outcome: File-change observation rejects every watcher event whose path relative to its watched root contains a .tmp component, before eligible-owner snapshot and path normalization or analysis. This excludes nested worktrees and scratch below the main checkout, while a session rooted in a .tmp/wt-* worktree still observes its own relative source files. No claim of causation for the Windows freeze or evaluation stalls is made without measurements.
acceptance: In record_file_change_captures, an event whose path relative to its watched root contains a .tmp component is discarded before the eligible-owner snapshot and before any path normalization or analysis. The regression proves no owner snapshot and no normalization happen, for a termal-test-state-* WAL and for a nested worktree file under the main checkout's .tmp.
Focused checks and the full gate pass on the landed input.
The read-only review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher finding.
